intendedUse: Operate the website as a supported customer-facing business channel, including receipt of enquiries.
workflowBoundary: A customer submits an enquiry through the website and the business receives, routes, responds to, and can support that enquiry.
workflowCompletion: An enquiry reaches the intended business process, failure is detectable, recovery/escalation exists, and the service can be maintained repeatedly.
movedBottleneck: Generation speed is no longer the constraint; reliable delivery, ownership, monitoring, and support are.
unhappyPath: The visible form can submit successfully in the browser while no authorised business recipient receives the enquiry.
authority: No production-operation authority is established by this sample record.
accountability: The operating organisation would need a named owner and recourse path before production use.
knownLimitations: The Deliverable gate has not passed because the enquiry path is not established end to end.
Operational monitoring, recovery, support ownership, and operating cost are not yet evidenced.
nextEvidence: Connect and test the real enquiry workflow, then establish ownership, monitoring, fallback/recovery, support, and the relevant operating-cost boundary.
stopRule: Do not operate the site as a customer enquiry channel until the Deliverable gate passes and the required operational controls are evidenced.
